scope: Recomputed metrics from per-sample true/predicted labels; checked JSON/CSV consistency, shared split membership, all-remaining-probe protocols, exact file SHA256 overlap and manifest actual file SHA256. No model training or feature extraction rerun.
limitations: Shared gallery checks verify recorded split counts and each reported matched_train_path; exported files do not contain every per-method gallery feature row, so this audit does not independently rebuild the feature matrix.
SHA256 overlap checks exact image-file bytes; near duplicates or identical decoded pixels in differently encoded files are not detected.
Aggregate timing summaries are recalculated from reported per-run times; wall-clock measurements are not independently repeated.
